name: web-framed-property-card-over-beach-villa-photo
title: White rounded card holding a villa photo and centred title over a beach house background
whatItIs: A full-bleed photo of a palm-lined beach house with a large white rounded rectangle on top. The left of the card holds a rounded photo of a villa terrace with a couple; the right has a heavy black centred title 'DAMAC LAGOONS', a dark app-style logo tile and two short paragraphs.
whatItMeans: Clean and aspirational; the white card imposes order over a busy holiday scene.
techniques: Lay a white card over a full-bleed photo to hold text.
Repeat the same imagery inside the card at rounded scale.
Centre a heavy caps title with a logo tile beneath.
Keep body text small and centred.
bestFor: Web project covers with a strong photo

vocabulary.definition: A solid card placed on a full-bleed image.
A rounded square holding a logo.
Title, logo and text aligned on the centre.
Using the same image at two scales.
